author: Nintendo of America
description:
Jump into the TMNT: Splintered Fate DLC today on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-splintered-fate-alopex-character-dlc-70050000066047-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

Meet Alopex, a mutant arctic fox and ninja assassin whose journey went from blind loyalty to Shredder to becoming a true friend of the Turtles. With mastery of her sickle-like kama, she slices at her foes with ease. Indebted to the Turtles, Alopex joins their fight to rescue Splinter. But things get complicated for her along the way as she faces off against her former sister-in-arms, Karai.   

Wield the dual kama claws. Unleash an arctic storm. Are you ready to jump in? 

#NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #TeenageMutantNinjaTurtles
